name: Famulor
tagline: Review AI assistants and omnichannel conversation history
description: Review Famulor assistant configurations, saved versions, available catalogs, and omnichannel call, messaging, and email history through an exact 11-tool read-only profile.

install.notes: Sign in with browser OAuth and approve assistants:read and calls:read for the target workspace. This profile cannot create, update, delete, send, call, purchase, run campaigns, manage telephony, or access billing.
